notes.title: Patch Update 1.2 - Player Skins
notes.content:
With Patch Update 1.2 players now have new ways to play their game in their own style.

Now introducing in game skins/costumes that players can earn with in game currency and switch their appearance while completing the game. Players can select from 11 different costumes from the original, 8 costumes being color swaps and 3 costumes completely changing the appearance of the ninja.
